content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We need the structure. No SMILES given. We have tools to get spectra: carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra. Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR ~1700 cm-1. Also carbon NMR around 190-220 ppm for carbonyl carbons. Could retrieve carbon shifts ranges. Probably easiest: get IR spectrum and look for carbonyl peak. Use ir_spectra tool.
